name: Honda CBX
engine: 1047 cc air-cooled DOHC 24-valve inline six, six carbs
intro: Honda's six-cylinder icon. Reliable if used. Six carbs are the big job on a bike that sat.

G: If the bike sits for weeks, modern fuel can clog all six carbs. Drain the carbs before storage.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Carbs after storage
known.what: Six Keihin carbs clog with modern fuel residue if the bike isn't run regularly.
